'''2003 Connecticut State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Connecticut (17 May 2003). According to his forum signature (captured December 2004), [[Bill Kafer]] was the "2003 CT State Champion".<ref name="pcf-4071-55509">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55509#55509 You will be missed...], Bill Kafer, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041226191332/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55465%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS4]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Connecticut
* '''Dates:''' 17 May 2003<ref name="pc-us03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040622065452/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/usevents.htm State Championships (US Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 June 2004.</ref>
* '''Time:''' 12pm<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Fee:''' $10<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Venue:''' Holy Trinity Lutheran Church, Terryville, Connecticut<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Josh Radke|Joshua Radke]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifier:''' [[Bill Kafer]]<ref name="pc-us03" />
